title: Keep prototype annotations precise and current

steps.action: Annotate one identifiable prototype element before its prototype and story endpoints exist.
steps.expected_result: The annotation remains structurally valid and reports both missing endpoints.

steps.action: Add the pinned prototype revision and current story revision.
steps.expected_result: The annotation becomes current and appears from both prototype and story.

steps.action: Revise both the prototype and the linked requirement without retargeting the annotation.
steps.expected_result: The annotation becomes stale and names both changed pins.

steps.action: Inspect a prototype with no annotation.
steps.expected_result: It appears as optional documentation growth rather than an approval failure.

expected_result: Annotations identify one prototype state and requirement, stale when either pin moves, and leave unlinked prototypes as optional growth.
